transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, doctor, it’s honestly gotten a bit out of hand, and my husband finally said I needed to talk to somebody about it. It’s... well, it’s wasps. I know it sounds silly, maybe, but I’m here because I’ve gotten to where I plan my whole entire summer around avoiding them. I used to love the summer, you know? But now, as soon as it starts getting warm, I’m constantly on edge. I even gave up my garden jobs at the church, which broke my heart because I loved taking care of the flowerbeds by the front sign, but there were just too many of them buzzing around the bushes. And at home, it’s just as bad. If I’m outside and I hear even the slightest buzzing sound, I just freeze up and have to go straight inside. I’ve started making my husband unload all the groceries or anything we bring home by the back porch if I hear anything that sounds like a wasp. I just can't be out there. I just can't do it. It’s like it’s taking over my life during the warmer months, and I just don't know how to stop being so afraid.
